# federation-runtime

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/federation-runtime.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `federation-runtime` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.pf`: generated from its catalogue, [federation-runtime.json](../../servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/federation-runtime.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_FEDERATION_`, `OIDF_REGISTRATION_`, `OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_`, `OIDF_PDP_`, `OIDF_BRIDGE_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

## Removed

Set in the source it was read from, a removed name is refused, naming what replaces it.

| Setting | Read from | Instead | Removed in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_BRIDGE_PRIVATE_JWK` | env | `OIDF_BRIDGE_SIGNING_KEYS` | 0.1.2 |
| `oidf.bridge.private.jwk` | system property | `OIDF_BRIDGE_SIGNING_KEYS` | 0.1.2 |
| `OIDF_BRIDGE_PREVIOUS_PUBLIC_JWK` | env | Nothing | 0.1.2 |
| `oidf.bridge.previous.public.jwk` | system property | Nothing | 0.1.2 |
